about: Verdicts of the real API stack for add_to_cart manifests: the global TrimStrings and ConvertEmptyStringsToNull middleware, then AppManifestValidator, from the API's master at the time the rows were taken. fixtureRows are the rows of add-to-cart-parity.json run through that same stack, by name; rows are CLI-sensitive cases of our own (slug, extensions and an optional dashboard, as a manifest body).
